paite: Huan TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah thu agen hi:
heading: TOUPA Omna Puanin Bawl Dia Nasemte / (Eks 35.30-36.1)

paite: "En in, Judah nam a Hur tapa, Uri tapa Bezaleel amin in ka samta hi.
Pathian Kha leh pilna leh theihsiamna leh theihna leh khutsiamna lam chiteng in amah ka dimsakta hi.
Ama'n khutsiamna in thil lim leh mel nei in agel dia, dangka-eng leh dangka leh dal in thil abawl ding hi.
Huai ban ah suangmantamte a-at dia, singte lim leh mel nei in khutsiamtak in abawl ding hi.
Aseppih ding in akiang ah Dan nam a mi Ahisamak tapa, Aholiab ka peta hi. Khutsiamna nei tengteng leng pilna lungtang ka peta a, amau nang ka hon thupiak bang in thil tengteng abawl ding uhi.
Kihoupihna puanin, theihpihna bawm, huai tung a om zahngaihna tutphah leh puanin vanzat tengteng;
Dohkan leh avante leh khawnvak koihna a van tengteng toh, gimlim maitam;
halmang thillat maitam, avan tengteng toh, tuikuang leh akhe;
nasepna puante leh siampu Aaron puan siangthoute leh atapate puansilhte, siampu nasepna mun a nasem ding in;
huan nilh theih thau leh Mun Siangthou a ding gimlim abawl ding ua, nang ka hon thupiak tengteng bang in ahih ding uhi," achi hi.
TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah thu agen hi:
heading: Sabbath Khawlni

paite: Israel suante kiang ah thu gen in, "Chihtaktak a ka Sabbath na tan ngeingei ding uh ahi. Na khang ua kei leh nou kal a chiamtehna ahih ziak in. Nou hon hihsiangthou, TOUPA ka hi, chih na theihna ding un.
Huaiziak in Sabbath na tang ding ua; nou a dia siangthou ahih ziak in. Kuapeuh hiai hihbuah sihsak ngeingei ding ahi. Kuapeuh hiai ni a nasem, amite lak a pan satkhiak ding ahi.
Ni guk sung nna septheih ahi dia; himahleh ani sagihna Sabbath, TOUPA a dia siangthou ahi. Sabbath ni a kuapeuh in nna khatpeuh asepleh, sihsak ngeingei ding ahi.
Huaiziak in Israel suante'n Sabbath ni atang ding ua, thukhun tawntung hi ding in, akhang-akhang un Sabbath ni atang ding uhi.
Hiai tangtawn in kei leh Israel suante kikal a chiamtehna ahi. Ni guk a TOUPA'N lei leh van abawl a, ani sagih ni akhawl a, atawldam ziak in," achi hi.
Sinai Tang tung a Pathian in Mosi houpih a, thu agen khit in theihsakna pek nih, suangpekte, Pathian khutzung a gelh, Mosi apia hi.
